linxia.name: 林夏
linxia.look: a 25-year-old East Asian woman with an oval face, shoulder-length straight black hair with soft bangs, natural makeup, wearing a beige double-breasted trench coat over a black turtleneck

shots.image: Cinematic vertical film still of a rain-soaked city street at night, neon signs in blue and magenta reflected in puddles on wet asphalt, light rain falling, empty street, wide establishing shot, moody atmosphere, 35mm film look.
shots.motion: Rain keeps falling and ripples spread across the puddles, neon signs flicker, the camera slowly pans right

shots.image: Cinematic vertical film still of {linxia}, looking back over her shoulder toward the camera with a startled, frightened expression, rain-soaked neon city street at night, medium shot, shallow depth of field, 35mm film look.
shots.motion: {linxia} walks forward, then suddenly stops and looks back over her shoulder, her eyes widen in fear, slight handheld camera
shots.line: 有人在跟着我……从地铁站出来就一直在。
shots.emotion: 紧张，压低声音，带一点颤抖

shots.image: Cinematic vertical film still of a tall man in a dark hooded raincoat standing under a flickering streetlight at the far end of a wet neon-lit street at night, face hidden in shadow, rain falling, long shot, ominous mood, 35mm film look.
shots.motion: The hooded man stands still under the flickering streetlight as rain pours down, the camera slowly pushes in toward him
shots.line: 雨越下越大，那个人影，始终保持着二十米的距离。
shots.emotion: 低沉的旁白，营造悬疑感

shots.image: Cinematic vertical film still, close-up of {linxia}, holding a glowing smartphone to her ear, rain droplets on her cheeks, neon reflections in her eyes, determined expression, night street, 35mm film look.
shots.motion: {linxia} presses the phone to her ear and glances over her shoulder, rain keeps falling, neon lights flicker, slight handheld camera movement
shots.line: 喂，110吗？我在长顺街，有人一直跟踪我。
